SAT algorithm:
For box, axes are the normals of its edges: (cos, sin) and (-sin, cos) for each. Compute projection of all vertices of B onto each axis of A, and vice versa. Find minimum penetration axis.

Let me implement generic.

```
function projectPoints(points, axis, min, max) { min=+inf; for p: d=dot(p,axis); min=d; max=d; }
```

For each box, compute its 4 corners in world space.

Then for axis in [A axes..., B axes...]:
  project A corners -> [amin, amax]; project B corners -> [bmin, bmax]
  separation = min(amax,bmin) - max(amin,bmax)
  Actually overlap = min(amax,bmin) - max(amin,bmax). If <=0 no overlap on this axis. Track min overlap (most negative) and its axis (normal = axis of the box that gives separating).

Let me follow standard:
```
let minPen = Infinity, normal = null;
for axis of A:
  projA, projB
  if max(projA) < min(projB) || max(projB) < min(projA): return null (separated)
  overlap = min(max(projA), max(projB)) - max(min(projA), min(projB))
  if overlap < minPen: minPen = overlap; normal = axis
for axis of B: same
if minPen == Infinity return null
```
normal is the separating axis direction. Push bodies apart along normal by minPen/2 each. Velocity response: relative velocity along normal, impulse.

For simplicity equal mass m=1, restitution e.

relV = (b.vx - a.vx, b.vy - a.vy)
vn = dot(relV, normal)
if vn > 0: no collision
impulse = -(1+e) * vn / (1/m_a + 1/m_b)
a.v -= impulse * normal / m_a
b.v += impulse * normal / m_b
```

function corners(b){
  const c = Math.cos(b.angle), s = Math.sin(b.angle);
  const ox = b.x, oy = b.y;
  const hw = b.w/2, hh = b.h/2;
  return [
    {x: ox - c*hw + s*hh, y: oy - s*hw - c*hh},
    {x: ox + c*hw + s*hh, y: oy + s*hw - c*hh},
    {x: ox + c*hw - s*hh, y: oy + s*hw + c*hh},
    {x: ox - c*hw - s*hh, y: oy - s*hw + c*hh},
  ];
}
function axisOf(b, i){
  const a = corners(b)[i];
  const b2 = corners(b)[(i+1)%4];
  return {x: b2.x - a.x, y: b2.y - a.y};
}
```
